name: El Astillero (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and red, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of El Astillero (a ship on red within an inscribed bordure, in an ornate frame).
history: Municipal flag of El Astillero; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: El Astillero arms — ship on red within an inscribed bordure
